purpose: Teach: 結び付け/可変/一望/財務諸表/苦心/降格/行きつけ/委嘱

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の結論と研究意義を結び付けろ
lines.en: Ren — connect the conclusions to the research significance.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Clear expectation delivered with quiet authority. Measured pace, slight pause before the verb. The tone of someone who knows Ren is capable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。可変パラメータの実験計画を作成しました
lines.en: Yes. I've drafted the experimental plan with the variable parameters.
lines.style: Earnest and careful. Quick uptake on the instruction. Slightly formal register — showing he's taken the direction seriously. Even pace, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室から自然が一望できると気分がいいぞ
lines.en: You know, having that view of nature from the lab — it does improve your mood.
lines.style: Gently reflective, almost to himself. Opens with conversational ease. Slower, more observational pace. A moment of shared thinking rather than directive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の財務諸表的な収支表を作りました
lines.en: Yes. I've also prepared a financial statement for the lab's accounts.
lines.style: Quick assent, then shifts into report mode. Slightly formal, perhaps trying to match what he thinks is expected. Steady delivery, no embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、苦心して書いた論文は心に響くぞ
lines.en: A paper written with real effort — that's what resonates with people.
lines.style: Softer tone, more philosophical. Speaking from experience. Slower, with weight behind the words. A gentle challenge wrapped in wisdom, not judgment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。不正研究で降格になった研究者もいると聞いてます
lines.en: Yes. I've heard that researchers have been demoted for research misconduct.
lines.style: Alert and serious. Ren picks up on the weight of what Hiroshi said. Formal, careful delivery — showing he understands the stakes. Even pace, no emotion bleeding through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、行きつけのカフェで論文を書くのも気分転換になるな
lines.en: Even writing at your regular café can be a good change of pace.
lines.style: Warm and conversational. Hiroshi offering permission to work differently. Relaxed pace, slight smile in the voice. A mentor saying: you don't have to do this one way.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。外部の専門家に査読を委嘱しました
lines.en: Yes. I've arranged for external reviewers to assess it.
lines.style: Closing confirmation. Ren showing he's already thinking ahead. Slightly more assured than before. Clean delivery, respectful but not stiff. Quiet completion.
